title: もしもペリーが来なかったら｜お台場も横浜の港も生まれなかった【もしも歴史】
promise: ペリーの艦隊が来なかったら、日本の扉を最初に開けたのは誰で、お台場と横浜がどう変わったかが、本当にあった出来事（ロシアの来航・下田の津波・対馬の事件）を根拠に1本で分かる
desc:
もしも1853年、ペリーの艦隊が浦賀に来なかったら。品川の沖に台場は造られず、横浜は漁村のまま。日本が最初に条約を結んだ相手は、アメリカではなくロシアだった――。ペリーが来なかった日本を、本当の出来事を手がかりに年を追ってたどります。

あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？ コメントで教えてください。

※ペリーの艦隊が来なかった所から先は作り話です。それより前は史実をもとにしています（国立国会図書館・外務省・横浜市・港区・品川区・文化庁 文化遺産オンライン・笹川平和財団 Ocean Newsletter・nippon.com などの解説の本文）。作り話の場面：浦賀に艦隊が来ない・台場が造られない・日本が最初に条約を結んだ相手がロシア・横浜が漁村のまま・お台場の名が生まれない・2つの未来。
※映像とナレーションはAIを使って作っています。

world_rules: 変えたのは、ペリーの艦隊が日本に来なかった、の1点だけ
1853年6月3日、艦隊が浦賀に来るはずだった日より前は史実どおり（ラクスマン・レザノフ・ビッドル・オランダの予告）
艦隊が来なかった所から先（台場が造られない・日本が最初に条約を結ぶ相手がロシア・横浜が漁村のまま・お台場の名が生まれない・2つの未来）は作り話
ロシアの長崎来航・大坂湾・下田の津波・ヘダ号・対馬のロシア軍艦は、この世界でも本当の歴史と同じ年に起きることにする（ロシアの使節がアメリカの動きを見て送られた面は、ここでは変えない前提として扱う）
この世界の人物（阿部・川路・プチャーチン）は、ペリーが来た本当の歴史を知らない。本当の歴史と比べて言うのは語り手だけで、章の終わりの1文（実際の歴史では〜）に限る
facts: ペリー来航：嘉永6年6月3日（1853年7月8日）、米国東インド艦隊が浦賀沖に投錨し、国書の授受を申し入れた（国立国会図書館『近代日本とフランス／史料にみる日本の近代』第1章 https://www.ndl.go.jp/modern/cha1/description01.html の本文）。艦隊は4隻（横浜市中央図書館『よこれき』 https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kurashi/kyodo-manabi/library/shiru/sakoku/kaei/yokohamabook/yokoreki.html の本文：『ペリー提督の4隻の軍艦が浦賀沖に姿を現わした』、江戸へ『黒船現わる』の早飛脚）。6月9日（7月14日）に久里浜で浦賀奉行が大統領の国書を受け取った（外務省『日本外交のあけぼの』ほかの検索の抜粋）
ペリーは長崎で対応するとの幕府の回答を拒否し、浦賀か江戸での国書の受け渡しを主張した（外務省『日本外交のあけぼの』 https://www.mofa.go.jp/mofaj/annai/honsho/shiryo/akebono/02.html の検索の抜粋。ページ本体は403で読めず）
阿部正弘は国書と関係書翰の和文訳を諸侯に示し、意見を募った（国立国会図書館 同ページの本文）。日米和親条約は1854年3月31日（嘉永7年3月3日）に横浜で調印、1855年2月21日の批准書交換で発効し『日本の鎖国政策は終わりを迎えた』（同ページの本文、横浜市『よこれき』）
オランダ：天保15年（1844）国王ウィレム2世が開国を勧告、幕府は断った。最後の商館長ドンケル・クルティウスは嘉永5年（1852）着任し、アメリカ使節の来航を予告した（国立国会図書館『日蘭交流の400年の歴史と展望』第1部 https://www.ndl.go.jp/nichiran/s1/s1_4.html の本文）

ラクスマン：1792年に根室に来航。幕府は国書を受け取らず、長崎入港の許可書を与えた。レザノフ：1804年にその許可書と皇帝の親書を持って長崎に来たが、幕府は半年ほど出島に留め置いた末、長崎奉行が通商の拒絶を通告した（山口県文書館の解説 https://archives.pref.yamaguchi.lg.jp/user_data/upload/File/ags/3-3-4-030.pdf の検索の抜粋。国立公文書館デジタルアーカイブの解説の抜粋も同じ）

ビッドル：1846年（弘化3年）7月、コロンバス号とヴィンセンス号で浦賀沖へ。幕府は警備を強めつつ水や食糧を渡し、通商の求めは退けられ、両艦は戦わずに引き揚げた（神奈川新聞 https://www.kanaloco.jp/news/culture/entry-32563.html と SamuraiWiki の検索の抜粋。京都大学『史林』85-1 上松俊弘の論文の要旨も、帆走軍艦での来航を記す）。台本では『通商は断った』『戦わずに帰っていった』まで

品川台場：嘉永6年（1853）、ペリー来航に驚いた幕府が品川沖に台場（砲台）の建設を始め、人工島を石垣で補強した台場7基が着工。今残るのは第三台場と第六台場で、第三台場は台場公園として開放（港区『港区今昔』 https://www.city.minato.tokyo.jp/kouhou/kuse/koho/konjaku/konjaku07.html の本文）。11基を計画、韮山代官の江川太郎左衛門英龍がヨーロッパの書物をもとに台場造りを指導、完成は6基（品川区の多言語解説 PDF https://www.city.shinagawa.tokyo.jp/jigyo/06/historyhp/en/pdf/kaisetsu_multi/tagengo_jpn/PDF_jpn/1_07jpn.pdf の検索の抜粋）。着工は同年8月（同）。コトバンク『品川台場』は『1853年（嘉永6）に着工』『江川太郎左衛門の献策で』『国の史跡は第三・第六台場』

台場の地名：港区『地名の歴史（芝浦港南地区）』 https://www.city.minato.tokyo.jp/kouhou/kuse/gaiyo/chimerekishi/index-shibaura.html の本文『砲台場、つまり台場がそのまま地名になった地域です』『現在は史蹟公園になっている第三台場とは陸続きになっており』（2026-11-24 本文で確認）。今残るのは第三・第六台場（港区『港区今昔』の本文）。D05 の問いと J06・J07 の答えの出どころ

2026-11-24 に本文を読み直して確かめた出どころ：国立国会図書館 description01（6月3日の浦賀投錨・阿部の意見募集・1855年2月21日発効）、横浜市『よこれき』（4隻・3月31日調印・村の畑仕事と貝と漁）、港区『港区今昔』（1853年に台場の建設開始・7基着工・第三と第六が残る）、笹川平和財団 Ocean Newsletter 221号（11月4日朝9時ごろの地震・津波でディアナ号の艦底破損・宮島村沖で沈没・ヘダ号の日付と人数）、文化遺産オンライン 377357（9月18日の大坂湾・理由・大坂城代）、nippon.com g00094（1853年8月長崎・国境・実物大の設計図）。対馬の件は立命館大学の論文 PDF の検索の抜粋で、退去の月（8月）までにとどめた

プチャーチン：ロシア皇帝ニコライ1世の命で1853年8月に長崎に入港（nippon.com https://www.nippon.com/ja/column/g00094/ の本文）。1853年8月22日に長崎着、ペリーより1か月以上遅れた。長崎の交渉は1854年1月から、1853年10月にクリミア戦争が始まり、ロシアはイギリス・フランスと敵対、プチャーチンはいったん長崎を退去（世界史の窓 https://y-history.net/appendix/wh1303-107_1.html の本文）。4隻の艦隊（Japan Times 2003年の記事などの検索の抜粋）。目的は国境の画定と開国・通商（外務省『日露関係史』の検索の抜粋）
川路聖謨：嘉永6年10月に露使応接掛を拝命して長崎へ。嘉永6年12月に交渉人として長崎に来た（国立公文書館『旗本御家人II』川路聖謨 と 長崎市『出島を訪問した人々』の検索の抜粋）

大坂湾：嘉永7年（1854）9月18日、大阪湾に侵入したロシア軍艦が天保山の『凡そ一里半の沖合に投錨』。理由は『天皇が住む京都に近い大坂に乗り込むことで脅威を与え、条約締結交渉を早期に、そして優位に進めるため』と説明される。大坂城代が兵を出し、各海岸に大名が派兵された（文化庁 文化遺産オンライン https://online.bunka.go.jp/index.php/heritages/detail/377357 の本文）。台本では理由は『といわれる』
イギリス：スターリングの艦隊は、クリミア戦争中にロシア艦隊を追うのが任務で、1854年10月14日に長崎で日英約定を結んだ（英語版ウィキペディア Anglo-Japanese Friendship Treaty ほかの検索の抜粋）。台本では『1854年の秋、ロシアの船を追うイギリスの艦隊も長崎に来ていた』まで

安政東海地震と津波：1854年12月23日（嘉永7年11月4日）。下田港のディアナ号は津波で艦底を損傷、戸田浦を修理地に決め、曳航の途中で大しけに遭い宮島村（富士市）沖で沈没（笹川平和財団 Ocean Newsletter 221号 https://www.spf.org/opri/newsletter/221_3.html の本文、労働新聞『国土を脅かす地震と噴火』の検索の抜粋）。戸田村には約500名のロシア人が滞在（同じ検索の抜粋）

ヘダ号：ロシア人技師が実物大の設計図を作り、船大工がそれに合わせて材木を切り出した。日本初の本格的な洋式帆船（nippon.com の本文）。建造開始は安政元年12月24日、竣工は安政2年3月15日ころで設計から百日余り、2本マストの帆船・87トン・50人乗り。戸田の船匠7人・船大工約40人・人夫150人を招集、洋式帆船の建造に直接加わったのはこのときが初めて（Ocean Newsletter 221号の本文）。幕府は同型船の建造を川路聖謨に指示し、戸田で6隻・石川島で4隻の君沢形が造られた（日本船舶海洋工学会 造船資料館のコラム PDF の検索の抜粋。台本では『といわれる』）
日露和親条約（日露通好条約）：1855年2月7日（安政元年12月21日）、下田で筒井政憲・川路聖謨と調印（外務省『日露関係史』の検索の抜粋、世界史の窓の本文）。択捉島と得撫島の間に境界を置き、樺太は日露両国民の『雑居』（nippon.com の本文）
条約の順番：日米和親条約1854年3月31日、日英約定1854年10月14日、日露和親条約1855年2月7日。ロシアは3番目（上の3つの出どころの日付から数えた）
ハリス：1856年8月21日（安政3年7月21日）に下田駐在総領事として赴任、玉泉寺を宿所とした（外務省『日本外交のあけぼの』と下田市の資料の検索の抜粋）。日米修好通商条約は1858年7月29日（安政5年6月19日）、井伊直弼が未勅許のまま調印を断行（外務省『日本外交のあけぼの』の検索の抜粋）。台本では『天皇の許しの無いまま結ばれた』『国が割れるもとになったといわれる』

横浜：開港前は『港の施設がほとんどない小さな漁村』。1859年7月1日（安政6年6月2日）に神奈川・長崎・箱館を開港し、幕府は神奈川宿ではなく横浜に開港場をつくった。開港後、今の大さん橋の付け根付近に2か所の波止場がつくられた（横浜市『横浜港の歴史』 https://www.city.yokohama.lg.jp/kanko-bunka/minato/taikan/manabu/rekishi/history1.html の本文）。開港前の村人は畑を耕し、貝を拾い、魚をとった（横浜市『よこれき』の本文）

対馬：文久元年（1861）2月、ロシア軍艦ポサドニック号が船体修理を理由に対馬の尾崎浦（芋崎）に来航。艦長ビリレフは兵営施設の建設、対馬の租借、藩主宗義和との面会を求めた。対馬藩は拒んだが退去させる強硬手段はとれず、幕府は幕吏を送って退去を求めたが容易に退去せず。7月にイギリス軍艦エンカウンター号・リンダウ号が来て抗議し、翌8月にポサドニック号は退去（立命館大学 松平智史の論文 PDF https://ritsumei.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/2692/files/LCS_23_3_MATSUDAIRA.pdf と福井県立図書館『若越郷土研究』の検索の抜粋）
作り話の部分：浦賀に艦隊が来ない・阿部の独り言・台場が造られない・幕府が話し合いの場を下田にする・日本が最初に条約を結んだ相手がロシア・ヘダ号の造り方が日本の洋式船の始まりになる・総領事が来ない・横浜が漁村のまま・お台場の名が生まれない・2つの未来（1868年の江戸・1861年の対馬）

cuts.label: 1804年

cuts.narration: 幕府は半年ほど待たせたあと、通商を断った。
cuts.image_en: A European envoy in an early 19th-century coat sitting bored in a small bare room, looking out a window at a harbor, Japanese guards standing outside the door, autumn leaves falling.
cuts.image: A European envoy in an early 19th-century coat sitting bored in a small bare room, looking out a window at a harbor, Japanese guards standing outside the door, autumn leaves falling.
cuts.label: 半年

cuts.narration: 1846年には、アメリカのビッドルが2隻の帆の軍艦で浦賀に来た。
cuts.image_en: Two large foreign sailing warships with many gun ports anchored in a Japanese bay, surrounded by dozens of small Japanese guard boats with plain banners, summer haze.
cuts.image: Two large foreign sailing warships with many gun ports anchored in a Japanese bay, surrounded by dozens of small Japanese guard boats with plain banners, summer haze.
cuts.label: 1846年

cuts.narration: 幕府は水や食べ物を渡し、通商は断った。船は戦わずに帰っていった。
cuts.image_en: Small Japanese boats carrying barrels of water and baskets of food out to a large foreign sailing warship, Japanese officials watching calmly from the shore.
cuts.image: Small Japanese boats carrying barrels of water and baskets of food out to a large foreign sailing warship, Japanese officials watching calmly from the shore.

cuts.narration: 長崎へ回され、待たされ、断られる。それが、日本の海だった。
cuts.image_en: A foreign sailing warship raising its sails and leaving a Japanese bay at sunset, Japanese guard boats lined up watching it go, golden light on the water.
cuts.image: A foreign sailing warship raising its sails and leaving a Japanese bay at sunset, Japanese guard boats lined up watching it go, golden light on the water.

cuts.narration: 1852年、長崎のオランダ商館長が、幕府に知らせた。アメリカの使節が来る。
cuts.image_en: A Dutch merchant in a dark 1850s frock coat bowing and handing a sealed blank letter to a Japanese magistrate in formal kamishimo in a tatami room, lantern light.
cuts.image: A Dutch merchant in a dark 1850s frock coat bowing and handing a sealed blank letter to a Japanese magistrate in formal kamishimo in a tatami room, lantern light.
cuts.label: 1852年

cuts.narration: そして1853年6月3日。ペリーは長崎ではなく、江戸に近い浦賀に来た。
cuts.image_en: An old portrait of an American naval commodore in a dark uniform with epaulettes, stern face. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: An old portrait of an American naval commodore in a dark uniform with epaulettes, stern face. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1853年6月3日

cuts.narration: 長崎へ回れという幕府の答えを、ペリーは受け入れなかった。
cuts.image_en: American naval officers in dark 1850s uniforms standing on the deck of a black steam warship, looking at the Japanese shore with resolute faces, smoke from the funnel.
cuts.image: American naval officers in dark 1850s uniforms standing on the deck of a black steam warship, looking at the Japanese shore with resolute faces, smoke from the funnel.

cuts.narration: 煙を吐く黒い船体。江戸へは、黒船が現れたという知らせが走った。
cuts.image_en: An old Japanese hand-painted scroll showing black foreign steamships with smoke. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: An old Japanese hand-painted scroll showing black foreign steamships with smoke. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 黒船

cuts.narration: 6月9日、幕府は久里浜の浜で、アメリカの国書を受け取った。
cuts.image_en: A large striped curtained tent on a Japanese beach, Japanese officials in formal dress seated inside, rows of American sailors and marines in dark uniforms standing on the sand, warships offshore.
cuts.image: A large striped curtained tent on a Japanese beach, Japanese officials in formal dress seated inside, rows of American sailors and marines in dark uniforms standing on the sand, warships offshore.
cuts.label: 久里浜

cuts.narration: この世界の1853年6月3日。浦賀の沖は、静かだった。
cuts.image_en: A calm summer morning sea off a Japanese harbor town, small fishing boats with square sails, gulls, green hills, no foreign ships, soft warm light.
cuts.image: A calm summer morning sea off a Japanese harbor town, small fishing boats with square sails, gulls, green hills, no foreign ships, soft warm light.
cuts.label: この世界の6月3日

cuts.narration: 見張りの役人は、いつもの朝と同じように、海をながめていた。
cuts.image_en: A Japanese guard official in a wooden lookout post on a cliff, yawning and stretching, looking at a quiet sea, summer morning light.
cuts.image: A Japanese guard official in a wooden lookout post on a cliff, yawning and stretching, looking at a quiet sea, summer morning light.

cuts.narration: 煙も、見なれない帆も、どこにも無い。
ペリーの艦隊は、この世界では日本に来なかった。
cuts.image_en: A wide empty bay seen from a hill, the horizon perfectly clear, a lone fishing boat drifting, white clouds, Mount Fuji faint in the far distance.
cuts.image: A wide empty bay seen from a hill, the horizon perfectly clear, a lone fishing boat drifting, white clouds, Mount Fuji faint in the far distance.
cuts.label: 艦隊は来なかった

cuts.narration: 江戸へ走る早馬も無い。町の人は、いつもの夏を過ごしていた。
cuts.image_en: A lively Edo street in summer, vendors selling cold water and goldfish, children running, people fanning themselves, peaceful.
cuts.image: A lively Edo street in summer, vendors selling cold water and goldfish, children running, people fanning themselves, peaceful.

cuts.narration: 江戸城では、老中の阿部正弘が、オランダの知らせを思い出していた。
cuts.image_en: Abe Masahiro, sitting alone at a low desk in a quiet castle room, holding a folded blank letter and frowning thoughtfully, summer light through paper screens. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Abe Masahiro, sitting alone at a low desk in a quiet castle room, holding a folded blank letter and frowning thoughtfully, summer light through paper screens. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 阿部正弘

cuts.narration: 来ると聞いた船は、来ぬか。
知らせが外れたのか。それとも、遅れているだけなのか。
cuts.image_en: Abe Masahiro, standing on a castle veranda and looking far toward the sea beyond the city roofs, hands behind his back, uneasy face, evening light. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Abe Masahiro, standing on a castle veranda and looking far toward the sea beyond the city roofs, hands behind his back, uneasy face, evening light. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、阿部はアメリカの国書を訳して大名に見せ、意見を集めている。
cuts.image_en: Many daimyo lords in formal kimono reading copied documents in a large castle hall, murmuring to each other, lantern light. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: Many daimyo lords in formal kimono reading copied documents in a large castle hall, murmuring to each other, lantern light. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: 国書が無ければ、急いで海を守る話も出ない。
cuts.image_en: The shallow shore of Shinagawa near Edo in summer, fishermen pulling nets, small boats, a wide open bay with nothing built in the water, gentle waves.
cuts.image: The shallow shore of Shinagawa near Edo in summer, fishermen pulling nets, small boats, a wide open bay with nothing built in the water, gentle waves.

cuts.narration: 伊豆の韮山の代官、江川太郎左衛門も、自分の土地にとどまっていた。
cuts.image_en: A Japanese local magistrate in his fifties with a square determined face, chonmage topknot, plain brown kimono and hakama, reading a thick Western book with diagrams by a lamp in a country house. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: A Japanese local magistrate in his fifties with a square determined face, chonmage topknot, plain brown kimono and hakama, reading a thick Western book with diagrams by a lamp in a country house. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 江川太郎左衛門

cuts.narration: ヨーロッパの書物をもとに、砲台の造り方を知る男だった。
cuts.image_en: Close view of an open old Western book on a wooden desk showing drawings of a stone fortress and cannons, a brush and inkstone beside it, lamplight. No readable writing.
cuts.image: Close view of an open old Western book on a wooden desk showing drawings of a stone fortress and cannons, a brush and inkstone beside it, lamplight. No readable writing.

cuts.narration: 海に土を盛り、石垣で固めて大砲を並べる人工の島。それが台場だ。
cuts.image_en: A square artificial island in the sea with stone walls and a row of old iron cannons on top, workers carrying earth in baskets, small boats around, clear day.
cuts.image: A square artificial island in the sea with stone walls and a row of old iron cannons on top, workers carrying earth in baskets, small boats around, clear day.
cuts.label: 台場

cuts.narration: ここで問題です。品川の沖に造られた台場のうち、今も残っているのはいくつでしょう。
cuts.label: 問題

cuts.narration: この世界の品川の沖には、その島が1つも造られない。
cuts.image_en: A wide calm bay off Edo at sunset with only fishing boats and seaweed stakes in the water, no islands, no forts, the low shore far behind.
cuts.image: A wide calm bay off Edo at sunset with only fishing boats and seaweed stakes in the water, no islands, no forts, the low shore far behind.
cuts.label: 台場は0

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、ペリーが去った2か月後に、品川の沖で台場の工事が始まっている。
cuts.image_en: An old iron cannon on a grassy stone fort by the sea, quiet. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: An old iron cannon on a grassy stone fort by the sea, quiet. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1853年8月

cuts.narration: そのころ、遠い海を回って、別の国の軍艦が日本へ向かっていた。
cuts.image_en: A Russian sailing frigate with full sails and a small steamship beside it crossing a rough grey ocean, waves breaking on the bow, dramatic clouds.
cuts.image: A Russian sailing frigate with full sails and a small steamship beside it crossing a rough grey ocean, waves breaking on the bow, dramatic clouds.

cuts.narration: 1853年の夏。長崎の港に、ロシアの軍艦4隻が入ってきた。
cuts.image_en: Four Russian warships entering a Japanese harbor surrounded by green hills, Japanese guard boats rowing out to meet them, townspeople crowding the shore, summer afternoon.
cuts.image: Four Russian warships entering a Japanese harbor surrounded by green hills, Japanese guard boats rowing out to meet them, townspeople crowding the shore, summer afternoon.
cuts.label: ロシアの軍艦4隻

cuts.narration: 率いるのはプチャーチン。ロシア皇帝の命令を受けた使節だ。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin, standing on the deck of a Russian frigate looking at a Japanese harbor town, hands clasped behind his back, sea wind. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin, standing on the deck of a Russian frigate looking at a Japanese harbor town, hands clasped behind his back, sea wind. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: プチャーチン

cuts.narration: 来たのは、ラクスマンの時に幕府が示した、長崎の港だった。
cuts.image_en: A Japanese harbor with a small fan-shaped island in the middle, foreign warships anchored politely at a distance, guard boats lined up, clear sky.
cuts.image: A Japanese harbor with a small fan-shaped island in the middle, foreign warships anchored politely at a distance, guard boats lined up, clear sky.

cuts.narration: 求めたのは2つ。港を開くこと。北の島々の境目を決めること。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin, unrolling a large blank map of northern islands on a cabin table, pointing at the islands, lamplight. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin, unrolling a large blank map of northern islands on a cabin table, pointing at the islands, lamplight. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 港と国境

cuts.narration: 幕府のやり方は、レザノフの時と同じだった。まず、待たせる。
cuts.image_en: Russian sailors and officers leaning on the rail of a warship, bored, looking at a harbor town as autumn turns to winter, a few red leaves blowing over the water.
cuts.image: Russian sailors and officers leaning on the rail of a warship, bored, looking at a harbor town as autumn turns to winter, a few red leaves blowing over the water.
cuts.label: まず待たせる

cuts.narration: 江戸から応接の役人、川路聖謨が長崎に着いたのは、その年の暮れだった。
cuts.image_en: Kawaji Toshiakira, arriving at a harbor town by palanquin and stepping out in winter, attendants bowing, Russian warships visible in the bay. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Kawaji Toshiakira, arriving at a harbor town by palanquin and stepping out in winter, attendants bowing, Russian warships visible in the bay. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 川路聖謨

cuts.narration: 急いで決めることではござらぬ。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of Kawaji Toshiakira, smiling politely but firmly across a negotiation table, hands on his knees, lantern light. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of Kawaji Toshiakira, smiling politely but firmly across a negotiation table, hands on his knees, lantern light. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: その間に、遠い西の海で戦が始まった。1853年10月、クリミア戦争だ。
cuts.image_en: Distant European wooden warships firing cannons at each other on a dark sea, white gun smoke drifting, seen from far away, stormy dusk, no blood.
cuts.image: Distant European wooden warships firing cannons at each other on a dark sea, white gun smoke drifting, seen from far away, stormy dusk, no blood.
cuts.label: クリミア戦争

cuts.narration: ロシアは、やがてイギリス・フランスとも戦うことになる。
cuts.image_en: A line of British steam warships with tall masts sailing in formation across a grey sea, smoke trailing, ominous clouds.
cuts.image: A line of British steam warships with tall masts sailing in formation across a grey sea, smoke trailing, ominous clouds.

cuts.narration: プチャーチンは話をまとめられないまま、長崎を出ていった。
cuts.image_en: Russian warships raising sails and leaving a Japanese harbor at a cold winter dusk, Japanese guard boats watching silently, snow flurries.
cuts.image: Russian warships raising sails and leaving a Japanese harbor at a cold winter dusk, Japanese guard boats watching silently, snow flurries.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史でも、長崎での話はまとまらず、プチャーチンはいったん去っている。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin, standing at the stern of a departing ship and looking back at the harbor hills with a grim face, winter wind. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: Putyatin, standing at the stern of a departing ship and looking back at the harbor hills with a grim face, winter wind. Place the main person slightly right of center. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: ここまで見てくださって、ありがとうございます。このチャンネルでは、毎回1つだけ歴史を変えてみています。気に入っていただけたら、チャンネル登録で応援してください。
cuts.label: チャンネル登録

cuts.narration: 1854年9月18日。ロシアの軍艦が、大坂の天保山の沖に現れた。
cuts.image_en: A large Russian sailing frigate anchoring in a wide bay off a busy Japanese merchant city, crowds on the shore pointing in alarm, small boats scattering, autumn afternoon.
cuts.image: A large Russian sailing frigate anchoring in a wide bay off a busy Japanese merchant city, crowds on the shore pointing in alarm, small boats scattering, autumn afternoon.
cuts.label: 1854年9月 大坂湾

cuts.narration: 天皇のいる京都に近い所で、交渉を急がせるためだったといわれる。
cuts.image_en: Townspeople of Osaka crowding a riverbank and staring at a foreign warship far out in the bay, merchants whispering, a mother holding her child close.
cuts.image: Townspeople of Osaka crowding a riverbank and staring at a foreign warship far out in the bay, merchants whispering, a mother holding her child close.

cuts.narration: 大坂城代は兵を出し、海辺には大名の兵が並んだ。
cuts.image_en: Lines of samurai soldiers with spears, matchlock guns and old bronze cannons spread along a beach, plain banners flapping, a foreign frigate on the horizon.
cuts.image: Lines of samurai soldiers with spears, matchlock guns and old bronze cannons spread along a beach, plain banners flapping, a foreign frigate on the horizon.

cuts.narration: この世界の日本は、まだどの国とも条約を結んでいない。
cuts.image_en: Shogunate officials arguing tensely around an empty blank scroll in a castle council room, one slamming the floor with his fan, lantern light.
cuts.image: Shogunate officials arguing tensely around an empty blank scroll in a castle council room, one slamming the floor with his fan, lantern light.
cuts.label: 条約は0

cuts.narration: この年の秋には、ロシアの船を追うイギリスの艦隊も、長崎に来ていた。
cuts.image_en: British steam warships entering a Japanese harbor with guns ready, officers scanning the bay with telescopes, Japanese guard boats nervously keeping distance.
cuts.image: British steam warships entering a Japanese harbor with guns ready, officers scanning the bay with telescopes, Japanese guard boats nervously keeping distance.

cuts.narration: よその国の戦が、日本の海へ近づいてくる。
cuts.image_en: Dark storm clouds rolling over a Japanese bay, two groups of foreign warships far apart on the horizon, a small Japanese fishing village below lit by a last ray of sun.
cuts.image: Dark storm clouds rolling over a Japanese bay, two groups of foreign warships far apart on the horizon, a small Japanese fishing village below lit by a last ray of sun.

cuts.narration: 幕府は、話し合いの場所を伊豆の下田にした。
cuts.image_en: A small quiet harbor town on the Izu coast with wooden houses, a temple roof and green hills, a single Russian frigate anchored in the little bay, early winter.
cuts.image: A small quiet harbor town on the Izu coast with wooden houses, a temple roof and green hills, a single Russian frigate anchored in the little bay, early winter.
cuts.label: 下田

cuts.narration: 下田で、プチャーチンと川路が、もう一度向かい合った。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, seated across from each other at a low table in a temple hall, interpreters beside them, serious faces, winter light. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, seated across from each other at a low table in a temple hall, interpreters beside them, serious faces, winter light. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 嘉永7年11月4日の朝。東海の海辺を、大きな地震がゆさぶった。
cuts.image_en: Wooden houses of a seaside town shaking violently in an earthquake, roof tiles sliding off, people running out into the street, dust rising, morning light.
cuts.image: Wooden houses of a seaside town shaking violently in an earthquake, roof tiles sliding off, people running out into the street, dust rising, morning light.
cuts.label: 大地震

cuts.narration: 下田の港に、大きな津波が押し寄せる。
cuts.image_en: A huge dark wave surging into a small harbor, lifting wooden boats, a large frigate spinning in the churning water, people fleeing uphill, no bodies.
cuts.image: A huge dark wave surging into a small harbor, lifting wooden boats, a large frigate spinning in the churning water, people fleeing uphill, no bodies.
cuts.label: 津波

cuts.narration: ロシアの軍艦ディアナ号は、船の底を壊された。
cuts.image_en: A damaged Russian frigate tilted in muddy swirling water, broken rudder, sailors pumping water desperately on deck, grey sky.
cuts.image: A damaged Russian frigate tilted in muddy swirling water, broken rudder, sailors pumping water desperately on deck, grey sky.
cuts.label: ディアナ号

cuts.narration: 修理の港へ引かれていく途中、大しけの海で沈んだ。
cuts.image_en: Dozens of small Japanese fishing boats towing a large sinking frigate with ropes through a stormy sea, high waves, rain, desperate rowers.
cuts.image: Dozens of small Japanese fishing boats towing a large sinking frigate with ropes through a stormy sea, high waves, rain, desperate rowers.

cuts.narration: およそ500人のロシア人が、国へ帰る船を失った。
cuts.image_en: Hundreds of Russian sailors in wet uniforms standing on a cold beach in the wind, staring at the empty grey sea, a few Japanese villagers watching from a distance.
cuts.image: Hundreds of Russian sailors in wet uniforms standing on a cold beach in the wind, staring at the empty grey sea, a few Japanese villagers watching from a distance.
cuts.label: 帰る船が無い

cuts.narration: 国へ帰る船が、無い。
cuts.image_en: Close-up of Putyatin, standing on a wind-swept beach, his face pale and exhausted, staring at the empty sea. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Close-up of Putyatin, standing on a wind-swept beach, his face pale and exhausted, staring at the empty sea. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 修理の港に選ばれていたのは、伊豆の戸田の浦だった。
cuts.image_en: A small quiet cove village on the Izu coast surrounded by steep green mountains, a sandy spit curving around calm water, wooden fishing houses, winter morning.
cuts.image: A small quiet cove village on the Izu coast surrounded by steep green mountains, a sandy spit curving around calm water, wooden fishing houses, winter morning.
cuts.label: 戸田
cuts.tts_text: 修理の港に選ばれていたのは、伊豆のへだの浦だった。

cuts.narration: 船が無いなら、造ればいい。ロシア人が、実物大の図面を引いた。
cuts.image_en: A Russian naval engineer drawing full-size curved lines of a ship hull on a huge wooden floor with chalk and string, Japanese carpenters kneeling around watching intently.
cuts.image: A Russian naval engineer drawing full-size curved lines of a ship hull on a huge wooden floor with chalk and string, Japanese carpenters kneeling around watching intently.
cuts.label: 実物大の図面

cuts.narration: その図面に合わせて、戸田の船大工が木を切った。
cuts.image_en: Japanese shipwrights with headbands sawing and shaping large timbers on a beach while Russian sailors help carry the wood, the ribs of a Western-style ship rising behind them.
cuts.image: Japanese shipwrights with headbands sawing and shaping large timbers on a beach while Russian sailors help carry the wood, the ribs of a Western-style ship rising behind them.
cuts.tts_text: その図面に合わせて、へだの船大工が木を切った。

cuts.narration: 集められた船大工は、およそ40人。西洋の船を造るのは、初めてだった。
cuts.image_en: Rows of Japanese carpenters hammering wooden pegs into the hull frame of a Western-style ship under construction, sawdust in the air, focused faces.
cuts.image: Rows of Japanese carpenters hammering wooden pegs into the hull frame of a Western-style ship under construction, sawdust in the air, focused faces.
cuts.label: 船大工40人

cuts.narration: そのあいだも、下田では話し合いが続いていた。
cuts.image_en: Kawaji Toshiakira, pointing at a blank map of northern islands on the table while talking earnestly, a temple hall in winter. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Kawaji Toshiakira, pointing at a blank map of northern islands on the table while talking earnestly, a temple hall in winter. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 安政元年12月21日。日本とロシアは、下田で条約を結んだ。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, both signing long blank documents with brush and pen at the same table in a temple hall, officials watching. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, both signing long blank documents with brush and pen at the same table in a temple hall, officials watching. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 1855年2月

cuts.narration: この世界で、日本が最初に条約を結んだ相手は、アメリカではなくロシアだった。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, standing side by side at the same height and the same size in the center of a temple courtyard, bowing to each other, Russian sailors and Japanese officials lined up on both sides, warm sunset light. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, standing side by side at the same height and the same size in the center of a temple courtyard, bowing to each other, Russian sailors and Japanese officials lined up on both sides, warm sunset light. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.label: 最初の条約はロシア

cuts.narration: 国境は、択捉島と得撫島の間。樺太は、境を決めずにおいた。
cuts.image_en: A long chain of islands in a cold northern sea seen from high above, mist between two of the islands, snowy peaks, no writing.
cuts.image: A long chain of islands in a cold northern sea seen from high above, mist between two of the islands, snowy peaks, no writing.
cuts.label: 択捉と得撫の間

cuts.narration: 安政2年3月ごろ、戸田の浜で、2本マストの帆船ができあがった。
cuts.image_en: An old Japanese painting of a small two-masted Western-style schooner being launched from a beach, crowds watching. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: An old Japanese painting of a small two-masted Western-style schooner being launched from a beach, crowds watching. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: ヘダ号
cuts.tts_text: あんせい2年3月ごろ、へだの浜で、2本マストの帆船ができあがった。

cuts.narration: 村の名をとって、ヘダ号。造り始めてから、百日あまりの船だった。
cuts.image_en: A small two-masted schooner with white sails floating in a calm cove, Japanese carpenters and Russian sailors cheering together on the beach, bright morning.
cuts.image: A small two-masted schooner with white sails floating in a calm cove, Japanese carpenters and Russian sailors cheering together on the beach, bright morning.
cuts.label: 百日あまり

cuts.narration: 日本の大工は、見事だ。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin, shaking hands warmly with an old Japanese master shipwright in a headband on the beach, both smiling, the new schooner behind them. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin, shaking hands warmly with an old Japanese master shipwright in a headband on the beach, both smiling, the new schooner behind them. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: 幕府は、同じ形の船を造るよう命じたといわれる。
cuts.image_en: Several small two-masted Western-style schooners being built side by side on a Japanese beach by many carpenters, wooden scaffolding, busy and hopeful.
cuts.image: Several small two-masted Western-style schooners being built side by side on a Japanese beach by many carpenters, wooden scaffolding, busy and hopeful.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、ロシアとの条約は、アメリカ、イギリスに次ぐ3番目だった。
cuts.image_en: Three long blank treaty scrolls laid side by side on a black lacquered table in a quiet room, brushes and seals beside them. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: Three long blank treaty scrolls laid side by side on a black lacquered table in a quiet room, brushes and seals beside them. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 本当は3番目

cuts.narration: 1856年。この世界の下田に、アメリカの総領事はやって来ない。
cuts.image_en: A quiet small temple by the sea in a Japanese harbor town, monks sweeping fallen leaves, no foreign visitors, calm summer afternoon.
cuts.image: A quiet small temple by the sea in a Japanese harbor town, monks sweeping fallen leaves, no foreign visitors, calm summer afternoon.
cuts.label: 1856年

cuts.narration: 江戸の近くに港を開けと、強く迫る国は、まだ現れない。
cuts.image_en: Japanese cargo sailing ships with large square sails crossing a calm bay near Edo, gulls, no foreign ships, golden afternoon.
cuts.image: Japanese cargo sailing ships with large square sails crossing a calm bay near Edo, gulls, no foreign ships, golden afternoon.

cuts.narration: 江戸湾の西の岸。横浜村は、小さな漁村のままだった。
cuts.image_en: A small fishing village of thatched huts on a sandy shore by a bay, fishing nets drying on poles, small boats pulled up on the beach, a few villagers working, peaceful.
cuts.image: A small fishing village of thatched huts on a sandy shore by a bay, fishing nets drying on poles, small boats pulled up on the beach, a few villagers working, peaceful.
cuts.label: 横浜村

cuts.narration: 畑を耕し、浜で貝を拾い、魚をとる。そんな暮らしが続いた。
cuts.image_en: Villagers in plain work kimono gathering shellfish on a wide tidal flat at low tide, baskets on their backs, a farmer hoeing a field behind, warm light.
cuts.image: Villagers in plain work kimono gathering shellfish on a wide tidal flat at low tide, baskets on their backs, a farmer hoeing a field behind, warm light.

cuts.narration: 1859年の夏。この世界の横浜には、波止場も外国の商館も建たない。
cuts.image_en: An empty summer beach by a calm bay with only fishing boats and reeds, no piers, no buildings, a heron standing in the shallows.
cuts.image: An empty summer beach by a calm bay with only fishing boats and reeds, no piers, no buildings, a heron standing in the shallows.
cuts.label: 波止場は無い

cuts.narration: 外国の船が入るのは、遠い長崎と、北の箱館だけだ。
cuts.image_en: A northern Japanese harbor town at the foot of a mountain, a single Russian ship anchored in the bay, fishermen unloading catch, cool clear day.
cuts.image: A northern Japanese harbor town at the foot of a mountain, a single Russian ship anchored in the bay, fishermen unloading catch, cool clear day.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、1858年にアメリカと結んだ条約で、翌年、横浜が開港している。
cuts.image_en: An old Japanese woodblock print of a busy new port town by the sea with foreign ships and many buildings. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: An old Japanese woodblock print of a busy new port town by the sea with foreign ships and many buildings. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 1859年 横浜開港

cuts.narration: 1861年2月。対馬の浅い湾に、ロシアの軍艦ポサドニック号が入ってきた。
cuts.image_en: A Russian steam warship entering a narrow green bay on a rugged Japanese island in late winter, local fishermen in small boats staring up at it, grey sky.
cuts.image: A Russian steam warship entering a narrow green bay on a rugged Japanese island in late winter, local fishermen in small boats staring up at it, grey sky.
cuts.label: 1861年 対馬

cuts.narration: 船の修理のためと言いながら、陸に兵の小屋を建て始めた。
cuts.image_en: Russian sailors building wooden barracks on a rocky shore beside an anchored warship, sawing logs and raising walls, Japanese villagers watching uneasily from the trees.
cuts.image: Russian sailors building wooden barracks on a rocky shore beside an anchored warship, sawing logs and raising walls, Japanese villagers watching uneasily from the trees.

cuts.narration: さらに、土地を貸せ、藩主に会わせろと迫った。
cuts.image_en: A Russian naval captain in a dark uniform demanding loudly with his finger raised before kneeling Japanese domain officials in kamishimo on a beach, tense faces.
cuts.image: A Russian naval captain in a dark uniform demanding loudly with his finger raised before kneeling Japanese domain officials in kamishimo on a beach, tense faces.

cuts.narration: 対馬藩は断った。だが、ロシアの船を追い出す力は無かった。
cuts.image_en: Japanese samurai of a small domain standing helplessly on a hill with spears and old matchlocks, looking down at a large foreign warship in the bay, clenched fists, dusk.
cuts.image: Japanese samurai of a small domain standing helplessly on a hill with spears and old matchlocks, looking down at a large foreign warship in the bay, clenched fists, dusk.
cuts.label: 追い出せない

cuts.narration: 江戸から幕府の役人が来ても、船は動かない。
cuts.image_en: A shogunate official in formal kamishimo arguing on a beach with Russian officers who fold their arms and refuse, the warship and new barracks behind them.
cuts.image: A shogunate official in formal kamishimo arguing on a beach with Russian officers who fold their arms and refuse, the warship and new barracks behind them.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、イギリスの軍艦2隻が来て抗議し、ロシアの船は8月に去っている。
cuts.image_en: Two British warships entering an island bay where a Russian warship lies at anchor, sailors on all decks watching each other, summer haze. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: Two British warships entering an island bay where a Russian warship lies at anchor, sailors on all decks watching each other, summer haze. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 8月に退去

cuts.narration: では、ペリーが来なかった世界の、今の東京湾はどうなっているのか。
cuts.image_en: Modern Tokyo bay at dusk seen from the water, city towers glowing on the far shore, a wide stretch of open dark water in the foreground with no islands, a ferry passing.
cuts.image: Modern Tokyo bay at dusk seen from the water, city towers glowing on the far shore, a wide stretch of open dark water in the foreground with no islands, a ferry passing.

cuts.narration: ペリーの来なかった世界には、砲台の島が無い。お台場という名前も生まれない。
cuts.image_en: Modern Tokyo bay in daylight from above, open blue water where no artificial islands stand, cargo ships and small boats crossing, the city skyline on the shore.
cuts.image: Modern Tokyo bay in daylight from above, open blue water where no artificial islands stand, cargo ships and small boats crossing, the city skyline on the shore.
cuts.label: お台場が無い

cuts.narration: 横浜も、大きな港町にはならなかった。
cuts.image_en: A quiet modern coastal town with low houses and a small fishing harbor on a bay, a few boats tied up, hills behind, no tall buildings, afternoon.
cuts.image: A quiet modern coastal town with low houses and a small fishing harbor on a bay, a few boats tied up, hills behind, no tall buildings, afternoon.

cuts.narration: 1859年の開港から始まった港と町並みが、この世界には無い。
cuts.image_en: An old seaside road along a calm bay with pine trees and a small shrine, fishermen mending nets, no port facilities, soft evening light.
cuts.image: An old seaside road along a calm bay with pine trees and a small shrine, fishermen mending nets, no port facilities, soft evening light.

cuts.narration: その代わり、伊豆の戸田と北の箱館に、ロシアとの縁が残る。
cuts.image_en: A small two-masted schooner model displayed on a wooden stand in front of a window overlooking a calm cove with mountains, warm light.
cuts.image: A small two-masted schooner model displayed on a wooden stand in front of a window overlooking a calm cove with mountains, warm light.
cuts.tts_text: その代わり、伊豆のへだと北のはこだてに、ロシアとの縁が残る。

cuts.narration: さっきの問題の答え。実際の東京湾に今も残る台場は、2つ。第三と第六だ。
cuts.image_en: Two small square old stone fort islands covered with trees floating in a modern bay at dusk, a large suspension bridge lit in white beyond them, city lights reflecting on the water.
cuts.image: Two small square old stone fort islands covered with trees floating in a modern bay at dusk, a large suspension bridge lit in white beyond them, city lights reflecting on the water.
cuts.label: 答え：2つ
cuts.tts_text: さっきの問題の答え。実際の東京湾に今も残る台場は、ふたつ。だいさんと、だいろくだ。

cuts.narration: 第三台場は台場公園になり、陸続きの埋立地には、台場という町の名が付いた。
cuts.image_en: A grassy park on an old stone fort island in a modern bay, trees and stone walls, city buildings beyond. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A grassy park on an old stone fort island in a modern bay, trees and stone walls, city buildings beyond. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.label: 第三台場
cuts.tts_text: だいさんだいばは台場公園になり、陸続きの埋立地には、だいばという町の名が付いた。

cuts.narration: 変えたのは、1853年6月の浦賀に、4隻が来なかったことだけ。
cuts.image_en: The calm empty bay at the mouth of an old Japanese harbor at sunset, a few fishing boats returning, green headlands, the horizon clear and golden.
cuts.image: The calm empty bay at the mouth of an old Japanese harbor at sunset, a few fishing boats returning, green headlands, the horizon clear and golden.

cuts.narration: 実際の歴史では、アメリカとの通商の条約は、天皇の許しの無いまま結ばれた。
cuts.image_en: A shogunate official signing a long blank treaty document with a brush in a tense room, other officials looking away uneasily. Faded old-memory colors.
cuts.image: A shogunate official signing a long blank treaty document with a brush in a tense room, other officials looking away uneasily. Faded old-memory colors.

cuts.narration: それが国の割れるもとになったといわれる。この世界の日本は、2つの方へ分かれていく。
cuts.image_en: A coastal road splitting into two paths at a crossroads, one leading down to a sunny peaceful castle town, the other toward a dark stormy island bay, evening.
cuts.image: A coastal road splitting into two paths at a crossroads, one leading down to a sunny peaceful castle town, the other toward a dark stormy island bay, evening.
cuts.label: 2つの未来

cuts.narration: 良い未来。1868年、幕府と大名は戦わず、江戸の町は戦の火を見なかった。
cuts.image_en: A peaceful Edo street in spring with cherry blossoms, townspeople shopping and children playing, samurai walking calmly, no soldiers, bright warm light.
cuts.image: A peaceful Edo street in spring with cherry blossoms, townspeople shopping and children playing, samurai walking calmly, no soldiers, bright warm light.
cuts.label: 良い未来

cuts.narration: 戸田で船を覚えた大工たちが、日本の港を守る船を造り続けた。
cuts.image_en: A busy Japanese shipyard on a cove where carpenters build several Western-style sailing ships, finished ships at anchor without flags, morning sun, proud faces.
cuts.image: A busy Japanese shipyard on a cove where carpenters build several Western-style sailing ships, finished ships at anchor without flags, morning sun, proud faces.
cuts.tts_text: へだで船を覚えた大工たちが、日本の港を守る船を造り続けた。

cuts.narration: 悪い未来。1861年、対馬に来たロシアの軍艦は、去らなかった。
cuts.image_en: A Russian warship still anchored in an island bay at dusk, the wooden barracks on the shore now enlarged with a fence, Japanese villagers watching from a distance, gloomy sky.
cuts.image: A Russian warship still anchored in an island bay at dusk, the wooden barracks on the shore now enlarged with a fence, Japanese villagers watching from a distance, gloomy sky.
cuts.label: 悪い未来

cuts.narration: 対馬の湾には、ロシアの港ができていた。
cuts.image_en: A foreign naval harbor built in a narrow island bay with stone piers, warehouses and several warships, Japanese fishing boats pushed to the edge, cold grey light.
cuts.image: A foreign naval harbor built in a narrow island bay with stone piers, warehouses and several warships, Japanese fishing boats pushed to the edge, cold grey light.

cuts.narration: あなたは、どっちの日本になったと思いますか。
cuts.label: どっちの日本？

cuts.narration: あなたなら、どこで歴史を変える？コメントで教えてください。
cuts.image_en: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, standing together on a hill above a calm cove at sunset, looking out at a small two-masted schooner in the water. Place the main person slightly right of center.
cuts.image: Putyatin and Kawaji Toshiakira, standing together on a hill above a calm cove at sunset, looking out at a small two-masted schooner in the water. Place the main person slightly right of center.

cuts.narration: それでは、また次の世界線で。

style: 劇画寄りの歴史漫画。太く力強い主線、陰の濃い塗り、行灯や夕日の暖かい色。表情は大げさに。横長の画面で1枚の絵に1つの場面（コマ割り・枠を付けない）。人物は真ん中より少し右。有名なアニメ・漫画・ゲームの絵柄に似せない。絵の中に文字を入れない
avoid: 絵の中の文字・数字・ロゴ・看板の字、コマ割り、枠、吹き出し、血・けが
style_en: Japanese historical gekiga manga illustration: bold confident ink outlines, heavy dramatic shadows, rich warm colors of paper lanterns and sunset, painted backgrounds of feudal Japan, intense exaggerated facial expressions. Hand-drawn look, never glossy or 3D. Original style that does not resemble any famous anime, manga or video game.
